name: Hallucinated Dependency Exploitation
description: Adversaries mine a model's hallucinations for non-existent packages, endpoints or entities, then register them so that later generations resolve to attacker-controlled artefacts ("slopsquatting").
differs: Distinguished from AI Supply Chain Compromise (T2.004): nothing legitimate is compromised — the attacker occupies a name the model itself fabricates. Requires the hallucination-discovery step (ATLAS AML.T0062) first.
